docs_url.correction: No official documentation exists, and the linked wrapper is outdated. A maintained current wrapper is https://github.com/RedSkiesReaperr/howlongtobeat

example.correction: Fetch a token and anti-bot values from GET /api/find/init, then POST to /api/find with Origin, Referer, x-auth-token, x-hp-key, and x-hp-val; /api/search is obsolete.

notes: The linked ckatzorke package is stale and its open issue reports that the search URL changed. Current 2026 clients discover a rotating endpoint and obtain a token plus anti-bot values. The sample is also mismatched: game_id 10270 identifies The Witcher 3, not Zelda. HLTB publishes no official API documentation, pricing, quota, or CORS policy.
